mascot.name: Pip
mascot.design: Original small elephant, a nod to (not a copy of) PHP's elePHPant. Round bean body about 80 x 70 card px when sitting at 1:1 scene scale, big soft half-disc ears, short stump legs, one tapered trunk stroke with a small curl at the tip, thin tail with an ink tuft, dot eyes only when facing camera, no mouth line, no tusks. Same ink as the world (theme ink, 3 px, strokes overshoot their joins) with flat fills offset by the misregistration constant. Usually seen from behind or 3/4 back, sitting on things (bench, toolbox, noticeboard top, watchtower roof, stoop step, chimney) exactly the way the reference cat sits on the noticeboard. Uses the existing pose set: sit-back, sit-front, stand-side, walk-side, peek, trunk-up, hold, ears-cover, shrug, sleep; expressions neutral, happy, wide, worried, meh, closed. Two requested extras (fallbacks given in each scene): 'trunk-cross' (hope) and a sneeze puff. Kept at panel edges and thirds, never in front of the explanatory object, never animated during a highlight wipe unless the gag illustrates that word.
mascot.colorway: Periwinkle (src/lib/mascot/colors.ts): body #8D90CC, shade #7377B5, inner ear salmon, cheek salmon, nails cream, ink theme ink. It is the only cool violet in the frame, so the eye finds him the way it finds the reference's orange cat, while the orange stays reserved for the sun and highlights.

scenes.vo: Government websites in four countries just switched themselves off. Nobody hacked them.
scenes.title: Civic Row goes dark

transitionIn.notes: Frame 0 is the pure line-art state of this composition (ink on white paper fills, no color), sun low at (480,440) half hidden behind the far buildings, Pip already in color on the bench in sit-back. This is exactly the frame S13 un-builds into, so the loop is invisible. Color floods in on the first word, the sun rises to its anchor.

scenes.setting: Civic Row: a one-point-perspective boulevard of four government buildings (two each side) on Web Street, the world where every website is a building and every visitor comes in through a door.
scenes.composition: Vanishing point (480,470), horizon y 470. Mint sky block x 150..810, y 95..470 (misregistered, like the reference's mint rectangle). Near-left civic A x 70..310, y 240..1010; far-left civic B x 300..430, y 360..610; near-right civic C x 650..890, y 250..1010 (hero door for S02 and S11); far-right civic D x 530..650, y 370..610. Distant low blocks at the VP x 420..550, y 400..470 (the sun hides behind them in frame 0). Pavement trapezoid narrowing from x 230..730 at y 1095 to the VP; crosswalk stripes y 1040..1080. Wire with 3 birds from (300,330) to (660,320). Bench on the right sidewalk x 610..810, y 930..1010 with Pip. Palette: facades cream/peach/tan, columns cream, pediments tan, doors teal, lit windows cream with salmon glow, dark windows tealDark, pennants in peach/sage/tan/teal patterns (no orange, not real flags). In the line-art state every shape keeps a white paper fill so it still occludes the sun.

beats.action: Frame 0 = line-art state: all ink, white paper fills, sun low at (480,440) behind farBlocks, Pip in color on the bench (identical to the last frame of S13).
sun rises from (480,440) to its anchor (480,100), ease-out with a 6 px overshoot, 0.8 s; passes in front of the sky block as soon as it clears the far roofs.
'Government': fills arrive building by building, wiping bottom to top, misregistered: civicA 0.16, civicC 0.28, civicB 0.40, civicD 0.50 (0.3 s each); sky fill 0.20.
'websites': every window lights up cream with a salmon glow in a front-to-back stagger, 0.56 to 1.05, like screens turning on.
street details fill (pavement, crosswalk, lamp posts); birds pop onto the wire with overshoot at 1.00.
'four': the four pennants hoist up their poles and pop open one per beat: A 1.36, B 1.52, C 1.68 ('countries' 1.60), D 1.84; each slides 0.18 s then flutters.
'switched': a cream power glyph draws on inside the sun (arc 2.32 to 2.55, stem 2.50 to 2.62). The sun stays orange.
'themselves': civicA's windows flicker and go dark (tealDark) and its plaque flips to the power glyph; civicC 2.96; civicB 3.12; panel micro-jolt 2 px on each.
'off.': civicD goes dark, the fourth click. The power glyph erases out of the sun 3.28 to 3.65; the pennants droop 10 degrees; birds hop once.
'Nobody': Pip hops off the bench and trots (walk-side) to civicC's door, 3.76 to 4.06.
'hacked': Pip tugs the door handle (hold); the door does not budge (Pip squashes, door rigid). The four lockPlates glint in sequence 4.10 to 4.30: intact, no damage, no intruder anywhere.
'them.': Pip turns to camera and shrugs (shrug, expression meh) 4.48 to 4.75.
camera starts its push into civicC's lock plate (zoom transition to S02).

scenes.sun: Rises from behind the far buildings to the anchor during the color flood (0.10 to 0.90). Becomes a power button at 'switched' (cream glyph drawn inside), glyph erases on 'off'. Back to a plain disc for 'Nobody hacked them'.
scenes.mascot: Pip sits on the bench (sit-back) in frame 0, the same pose the loop lands on. Ears droop a little as each building goes dark (2.80 to 3.28). 'Nobody': trots to the near door; 'hacked': tugs the handle, it holds; 'them': shrug to camera.

scenes.mascot: Sits on the toolbox watching the fix; the double take at 'PHP' is the first rewatch gag (he is the elephant on the plate). Rides the pull-backs by re-seating: press house sign bracket, then the top terrace roofline, counting the lit plates with small trunk taps.

loop: The film opens and closes on the same frame: Civic Row in pure line art (ink on white paper fills), the sun half hidden behind the far buildings at (480,440), Pip in color on the bench in sit-back, and an empty caption zone. S13's un-build (69.84 to 70.60) collapses every fill into one tan block that slides down out of the panel, revealing that line art behind it, while the sun sets to (480,440) and Pip hops onto the bench. The last caption rolls out from 70.52 to 70.687; the first caption rolls in from 0.00 to 0.16, so the seam falls on an empty caption zone. On replay the color floods back and the sun rises again (0.10 to 0.90): the ending reads as the beginning. Audio: sfx tails die before 70.687, and the frame-0 whoosh swell starts at 0.10, so the cut is clean.
